text: Because the Dutch Supreme Court's World Online presumption of reliance can be extended to ad hoc disclosure violations and misleading periodic reports, the Dutch legal system could compete effectively with the United States by lowering the crucial reliance threshold in securities actions.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Richard W. Painter, Forum Competition and Choice of Law Competition in Securities Law after Morrison v. National Austral (2012). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2029983

isBasedOn.name: Forum Competition and Choice of Law Competition in Securities Law after Morrison v. National Austral

abstract: These developments suggest that the Dutch legal system could effectively compete with the United States, at least as it pertains to lowering the crucial threshold re- quirement of reliance in securities actions.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: Dutch courts extend World Online beyond prospectus liability
